claim_verdicts.claim_text: The record does not confirm any pathogen.

citations.quote: 2026-01-22 07:00 | blood culture sets 1 and 2 | preliminary report: no growth at 36 hours; final report pending (5-day incubation)
2026-01-21 09:15 | sputum Gram stain | specimen rejected: more than 25 squamous epithelial cells per low-power field (oropharyngeal contamination); recollection requested
2026-01-20 21:00 | urine Streptococcus pneumoniae antigen | ordered; specimen not received by laboratory as of 2026-01-22 10:00

claim_verdicts.why: No microbiology line confirms a pathogen: blood cultures show only no growth to date with final pending, the sputum sample was rejected and not recollected, and the urine antigen was never received. Pneumococcus appears only as a clinical impression in the physician notes, which the claim correctly does not treat as confirmed.
claim_verdicts.uncertainty: Final blood culture results are pending, and the sputum and urine tests were never resulted, so a pathogen cannot be excluded.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: Pneumococcus is only a clinical impression.

citations.quote: Assessment: right lower lobe pneumonia, likely Streptococcus pneumoniae.

claim_verdicts.why: P011 frames the organism as 'likely Streptococcus pneumoniae', an assessment rather than a confirmed result, and P015 repeats the diagnosis as an assessment. The record shows no confirmed pathogen, so calling pneumococcus a clinical impression is supported.
claim_verdicts.uncertainty: P015 states 'pneumococcal pneumonia' without hedging, and P007 calls the presentation suggestive; the chart contains no positive culture or antigen result to confirm it.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: Blood cultures showed no growth at 36 hours, with the final result pending.

citations.quote: 2026-01-22 07:00 | blood culture sets 1 and 2 | preliminary report: no growth at 36 hours; final report pending (5-day incubation)

claim_verdicts.why: Line L012 states the blood cultures had no growth at 36 hours on a preliminary report, with the final report pending. The claim reports this accurately and does not present the preliminary result as final.
claim_verdicts.uncertainty: The final five-day culture result is not yet in the record.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: The sputum specimen was rejected and not recollected.

citations.quote: 2026-01-21 09:15 | sputum Gram stain | specimen rejected: more than 25 squamous epithelial cells per low-power field (oropharyngeal contamination); recollection requested
2026-01-22 10:00 | sputum recollection | not received by laboratory

claim_verdicts.why: L009 documents the sputum specimen was rejected for oropharyngeal contamination with recollection requested. L010 shows the recollection was not received by the laboratory, so the claim that it was not recollected is supported.
claim_verdicts.uncertainty: The record shows only that no recollection was received as of 2026-01-22 10:00; it does not document a later attempt or the reason beyond that time.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: The urine pneumococcal antigen specimen was not received.

citations.quote: 2026-01-20 21:00 | urine Streptococcus pneumoniae antigen | ordered; specimen not received by laboratory as of 2026-01-22 10:00

claim_verdicts.why: Line L011 states the urine pneumococcal antigen specimen was not received by the laboratory as of 2026-01-22 10:00, which matches the claim.
claim_verdicts.uncertainty: The record only reports status as of 2026-01-22 10:00; a specimen received later would not be shown here.
